how: Hand-labelled 2026-10-14 by the Dedup lab agent from dd_label_view.py 10 (seeded sample, Jaccard 0.4 to 1, each document at most once). Labels: B = both documents are boilerplate or an extraction failure (cookie banner, bot check, forum or shop chrome); S = the same text copied (a template legal page, a notice); T = a template page whose only difference is the item it describes; D = different main content that shares boilerplate. remove: should a dedup step drop one of the two? yes, no, or either (little is lost either way).
